chapters.title: Convert to integers and back

frames.caption: Convert to integers and back — O(m + n) time, O(m + n) extra space. Input: add_two_numbers(l1=list (9), l2=list (9)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.

chapters.title: Digit by digit with a carry
chapters.code:
def add_two_numbers(l1, l2):
    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    carry = 0
    while l1 or l2 or carry:
        total = carry + (l1.val if l1 else 0) + (l2.val if l2 else 0)
        carry, digit = divmod(total, 10)
        tail.next = tail = ListNode(digit)
        l1 = l1.next if l1 else None
        l2 = l2.next if l2 else None
    return dummy.next
